name: test_quarantine_applies_only_to_the_listed_environments
description:
Objective: A Staging-only known issue does not quarantine the test in QA or production.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Evaluate issues_for for a Staging-only product defect in staging, qa and prod.
Expected: 1. Quarantined only in staging.
